title: Recognising the T3 axes is part of the bigger work on semantics at scale; the-system-networks applies them to mapping networks (2026-11-04)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: Lets look at an encoder fine tune. the-system-networks is a human facing website that applies the axes to mapping networks -- actors within a boundary. The ability to recognise the T3 axes is part of a our bigger work into working with semantics at scale. It goes deeper than decisions directly, and is worth the continued work to validate
